description: E2: a lead only (milestone E builds what lies behind it). After the Cinder Titan's fall Ysolde tells her herder's tale: on the ridge north of the Breach a giant king in armour, still as stone, with the sunrise through him and nothing inside - the last of the giant kings, the songs say, who went against the Worldbreaker and did not come back. The lead is heard and noted in the journal (lead.hollow.heard); nothing of the Hollow Titan is built.

stages.objective: Heard: an empty king standing on the ridge north of the Breach
stages.waiting_text: A herder's tale is all there is yet: a giant king in armour on the high ridge, with nothing inside.
